name: Engineers
description: Internal (in-house) engineers available for direct job assignment. Used by hybrid assignment logic to decide whether a job should be handled internally or sent to an external contractor.
record_count_estimate: Low volume - typically 5-30 internal engineers per property portfolio

fields.name: engineer_id
fields.description: Unique auto-incrementing identifier for each engineer

fields.name: name
fields.description: Full name of the internal engineer

fields.name: person_id
fields.description: Link to the People table record for this engineer (used for WhatsApp messaging via Scenario C)

fields.name: trade_disciplines
fields.description: Trade disciplines this engineer is qualified to handle

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current availability status of the engineer

fields.name: rating
fields.description: Internal performance rating (1-5). Used for assignment priority.

fields.name: current_open_jobs
fields.description: Number of currently assigned open jobs. Updated by Scenario B on assignment/completion.

fields.name: max_concurrent_jobs
fields.description: Maximum number of concurrent jobs this engineer can handle

fields.name: cost_threshold
fields.description: Maximum estimated job cost this engineer can handle without RFQ escalation to PM. Jobs above this threshold may trigger RFQ.

views.name: Available by Trade
views.description: Available engineers grouped by trade discipline

views.name: Workload Overview
views.description: All active engineers sorted by current workload
